layout.description: Reference for lab technicians building forms: every question type the form engine supports.

index.title: Component reference
index.subtitle: A reference for lab technicians building forms. Every question type the form engine supports — pick one from the sidebar to customize its JSON fields and see a live preview.
index.templateBody: An experiment template is the top-level document the form engine loads. It pairs two forms — clientForm and labForm — each a FormDoc with a name, optional description, and a questions array. Named calculations map variable names to objects with a Python formula (evaluated by the backend) and an optional computed result. Collected answers live in values, keyed by question id.
index.repeatableBody: A repeatable group is a fixed-count repeating section — for example, “measure the sample 8 times”. It may include an optional itemLabel and a list of child questions in its config. Only one level of nesting is supported: a repeatable group cannot contain another repeatable group. Answers are stored columnar: each child question id maps to an array of length count (one entry per repetition).
index.schemaBody: The experiment-template.schema.json JSON Schema below is the source of truth and is what the backend matches. The Zod schemas in @repo/forms (schema.ts), used for runtime validation and types in the frontend, are written by hand to mirror that JSON Schema. They are kept in sync manually — an accepted bit of tech debt, since the schema does not change often. When you change one, change the other.
